item.title: [fullscreen] Mention different behavior when fullscreen is toggled by the browser
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/fullscreenElement

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Document: fullscreenElement property

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The description reads (emphasis mine):

The Document.fullscreenElement read-only property returns the Element that is currently being presented in fullscreen mode in this document, or null if fullscreen mode is not currently in use.

I think it is a bit deceiving, because if fullscreen is enabled by the browser after a user presses F11 (on Chromium), the property is null as well.

What did you expect to see?

I think that it would be helpful to mention that the behavior when fullscreen is toggled by the browser (when F11 is pressed) is different than that when fullscreen is toggled programmatically (using the Fullscreen API).

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response
